message:
What many of you have been waiting for, limited seats available!!!

Join my Cybersecurity hands-on intensive LIVE training. 

With the increasing frequency and sophistication of cyber threats, the need for skilled Cybersecurity professionals is skyrocketing. This training will help you unlock a wealth of opportunities with potential for lucrative, high-paying jobs in the cybersecurity field. 

Learn essential skills, from compliance frameworks to system hardening, encryption to vulnerability management. Gain hands-on experience with popular security tools, tackle common cyber attacks, and learn about log management.

Enroll now to seize your chance in this thriving industry and pave the way for a successful career in cybersecurity. 

Don't miss out on this promising pathway to professional growth and the potential for a high paying Cybersecurity career.

Topics Covered:

Cybersecurity Terminologies

Compliance: Frameworks/Laws/Certifications

System hardening - Hands-on

Using Strong Password

Setting up MFA for a Server

Adding SSH keys to a server

Encryption lab

Popular Security Tools

iptables

Nmap

Snort

Wazuh (OSSEC)

Manage Engine

Vulnerability Management

Nessus

OpenVAS

Common Cybersecurity Attacks

OWASP Top 10 - Overview

Log Management.

Signing up for this live training provides you with free unlimited access to my on-demand course bundle so you never have to pay the monthly fee.

Limited seats available. Sign up now to reserve your spot before it's sold out!

https://bit.ly/cybertrmk
